_comment: EXTRA (not Phase 1). Fighter, APPROXIMATE. Flies FD's prepared copy flight-dynamics/jsbsim_root/aircraft/f16 (prepare_aircraft: no network I/O, flex external reactions + point masses). The F-16 is fly-by-wire: elevator/aileron-cmd-norm are pitch-rate/g and roll-rate DEMANDS to the JSBSim FCS, not surface commands, so the derived controller gain bounds below are PROVISIONAL and UNTUNED (they need their own derivation; FD INTERFACE.md 5d).
name: f16

sources.geometry_inertia: JSBSim 1.3.1 stock model aircraft/f16/f16.xml (metrics, mass_balance) -- itself an approximate public model
sources.mass_lb: FD INTERFACE.md 5b: JSBSim f16 as loaded 20,630 lb (17,400 empty + 230 pilot + 3,000 internal fuel)
sources.speeds_n: approx: +9/-3 g (public), stall ~130 KCAS rough, Vne placeholder 800 KCAS
sources.control_limits: approx public: stabilator +/-25 deg, flaperon ~21.5 deg, rudder +/-30 deg
sources.max_thrust_lbf: approx dry (military) thrust, F100/F110 class ~17,000 lbf
sources.control_derivatives: cm_de rough all-moving-tail estimate (not from the JSBSim tables); others generic
sources.sim_envelope: approx 1.15 x rough Vstall; public g limits
sources.design_point: FD INTERFACE.md 5 / Evolution Runner trim point 350 KCAS, 10,000 ft (M0.629); full trim, gear up, dry throttle cmd 0.284
sources.aircraft_root: FD prepared copy (INTERFACE.md 5a): no network sockets, flex external reactions after pushback/hook, zero-mass patch flies bit-identically to stock
sources.flex_constants: FD INTERFACE.md 5e (2026-10-06): fixed x_ea 0.40 / x_cg 0.43 (CG aft of EA), tip mass 0; flutter margin 1.39 at the default structure, minimum 0.963 at s 0.6 / r 0.8 (fails), >= 1.10 for s >= 0.8; divergence not found below the 3.0 cap. Notional structural data.
sources.point_masses: FD INTERFACE.md 5a: payload_placeholder (0, 0 lb at the CG), Pilot (1), flexwing_dm_R/L (2/3); robust-scenario payload deltas go to index 0
sources.gain_bounds: PROVISIONAL, UNTUNED: derived by the generic rule from rough data; the FBW FCS makes the controller channels rate/g demands (FD INTERFACE.md 5d finding 3)

gain_bounds_provisional: FBW: stick inputs are pitch-rate/g and roll-rate demands to the JSBSim FCS (proportional, no integrator; +1/-0.44 stick clip, alpha limiter), so the surface-authority range rule does not apply. Bounds are derived placeholders, untuned; derive them for the FCS before any F-16 evolution run.
